name: event_id
description: Event identifier unique within source_class (table event_id, span:<trace_id>:<span_id>, or _AllLogs.insert_id).

name: event_time
description: Event UTC timestamp filtered by [from_time, to_time).

name: event_type
description: Canonical event taxonomy name (outcome.*, action.committed, guardrail.intervention, state.transition, feedback.*, etc.).

name: source_system
description: Emitter system identifier.

name: source_class
description: Landing-place writer class: system_of_record, platform, or application.

name: is_authoritative
description: TRUE exclusively for rows written to the system-of-record copy of workflow_events; FALSE otherwise.

name: trace_id
description: Associated W3C 32-hex trace identifier (bare hex normalized).

name: span_id
description: Associated W3C 16-hex span identifier.

name: response_id
description: Associated gen_ai.response.id.

name: outcome_id
description: Primary outcome.id associated with the event.

name: linked_outcome_id
description: Secondary outcome ID lifted from payload_json on outcome.linked rows.

name: outcome_status
description: Terminal outcome.status lifted from closing span or workflow_events.payload_json.

name: state_transition_to
description: Target state (Guide or Answer) lifted from workflow_events.payload_json on state.transition rows.

name: conversation_id
description: Associated gen_ai.conversation.id.

name: trace_owner_app_id
description: Owning application ID resolved via trace_id else outcome.owner.

name: action_id
description: Mutating action correlation identifier.

name: nudge_id
description: Optional per-recommendation nudge_id.

name: control_id
description: Guardrail control identifier on guardrail.intervention rows.

name: control_layer
description: Guardrail control layer: gateway, dlp, model_armor, or app_rule.

name: control_action
description: Guardrail action: block, redact, or shadow.

name: approved_expires_at
description: Approval expiry UTC timestamp on outcome.approved rows.

name: feedback_reason
description: Structured feedback code from _AllLogs labels or workflow_events.payload_json.

name: duplicate_count
description: Count of later identical repeats of (source_class, event_id) (0 when none).

name: conflict_count
description: Count of later repeats of (source_class, event_id) with differing content (0 when none).

name: labels
description: Open-safe registered slice-only attributes JSON object.
